claims.statement: Departs for Mantua and Venice, probably in company with Luca Pacioli. Records show 600 florins placed at Santa Maria Nuova in Florence on 14 December 1499.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Hospital account of Santa Maria Nuova; the companionship with Pacioli is an inference.
